requirements.description: At least 30 independently reviewed tasks enter as natural-language user messages without target, filters, retrievalIntent, qrels, or Gold exposed to the product.
The configured Agent model runs the public DSH path through query compilation, knowledge assessment, tools, and a final TicketResultCollection.
The same cases report first Provider ranking and final Agent collection Precision, Recall, nDCG, result count, tool cost, and trajectory changes.
A predeclared statistical non-degradation rule shows that the final Agent collection is not systematically worse than the first Provider ranking.
Domain reviewers confirm qrels, acceptable alternatives, exclusions, clarification expectations, and result-set semantics.
